newsitem.title: MEXICO: TAMSA says debentures converted, retired.
newsitem.headline: TAMSA says debentures converted, retired.

text.p: Steel pipe maker Tubos de Acero de Mexico SA said on Tuesday that as of the close of business on June 5 all $50 million of its 7.5 percent convertible debentures due in 1997 have been converted or retired.
As a result, the company's scheduled repayments of long-term debt during 1997 have been reduced by $50 million, the company said in a statement.

The total disbursement by TAMSA for retiring the convertible debentures was about $45 million, and the total dilution affecting stockholders as a result of the conversion was about 2.25 percent, the company said.
